name: Porcini Mushroom Beanotto with Pine Nuts
steps: Soak dried porcini in 100ml hot water for 5 min. Drain, keep the soaking liquid, and chop.
Toast pine nuts in a dry pan 2 min until golden. Set aside.
Dice onion and garlic. Slice chestnut mushrooms.
Heat oil in a wide pan. Cook onion and garlic 2 min, then add both mushrooms for 4 min.
Add beans, stock and porcini soaking liquid. Simmer 6–8 min, lightly mashing some beans for a creamy texture.
Stir in grated parmesan. Top with toasted pine nuts and chopped parsley.
